biotools.summary: No-code web platform for reproducible single-cell RNA-seq analysis that scales to millions of cells. Users upload an AnnData (.h5ad) count matrix, choose a tissue, and receive a complete HTML report plus the processed results: cell-type prediction by an scANVI classifier trained on 15 human and mouse reference atlases with per-cell confidence, quality control, marker analysis, differential expression across conditions, transcription factor, pathway and gene-set activity scoring, and novel-population detection.
